name: Baretara Soku Taiho! Lolikko Tousatsu Daisakusen
original_name: バレたら即逮捕!ロリッ娘盗撮大作戦
source:
An ADV tale of voyeurism, exhibition and love.
"You" are a hobbyist photographer who's willing to risk it all.
Let's not beat about the hairless pudenda, if you're spotted it's instant jailtime... and yep, they've seen you! But the truth is these precocious lolis are the exploiters.
"Play with us or we'll tattle on you to mister policeman!"


[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ184424.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
